terra.problem: The text says Herod heard reports, but does not say there were only a few.
John telling Herod does not establish that he never whispered it to a friend hoping it would be passed along.
The text says Herod was pleased, but does not describe his facial expression.
The text does not say Herod made his promise quickly.
Her mother prompted her, but the text does not specify that she spoke to her.
Saying Herodias 'gets her say' adds that she spoke, while the text says only that she prompted her daughter.
